LanguageData.RR_ConnectedWork_InvalidState: Cross-gate work is unavailable right now.
LanguageData.RR_ConnectedWork_InvalidSave: The saved cross-gate work records did not pass their integrity check, so cross-gate work is disabled. Nothing was altered; keep this save.
LanguageData.RR_ConnectedWork_AdapterRetired: That work trip was planned by an older version of this build and will not be carried out under changed rules.
